## Sontek QAQC for L2 Shiny
```{r Run L2 QAQC App New}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare the FULL dataset once
# --------------------------------------------------

qa_data <- dat_yyyy %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    water_depth = as.numeric(water_depth),
    index_velocity = as.numeric(index_velocity),
    suspect_depth = FALSE,
    suspect_velocity = FALSE,
    noise_depth = FALSE,
    noise_velocity = FALSE,
    month = floor_date(timestamp, "month")
  ) %>%
  arrange(timestamp)

# Preserve existing manual flags if the previous app's
# qa_data_flagged dataframe is still available.
# Assumes the source rows are in the same order.
if (exists("qa_data_flagged", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {

  previous_data <- get("qa_data_flagged", envir = .GlobalEnv)

  if (nrow(previous_data) == nrow(qa_data)) {

    if ("suspect_depth" %in% names(previous_data)) {
      qa_data$suspect_depth <- previous_data$suspect_depth
    } else if ("suspect" %in% names(previous_data)) {
      # Migrate the old single suspect column to depth flags
      qa_data$suspect_depth <- previous_data$suspect
    }

    if ("suspect_velocity" %in% names(previous_data)) {
      qa_data$suspect_velocity <- previous_data$suspect_velocity
    }
    
    if ("noise_depth" %in% names(previous_data)) {
      qa_data$noise_depth <- previous_data$noise_depth
    }

    if ("noise_velocity" %in% names(previous_data)) {
      qa_data$noise_velocity <- previous_data$noise_velocity
    }
  }
}

available_months <- sort(unique(na.omit(qa_data$month)))

# Persistent working dataframe in the current R session
qa_data_flagged <- qa_data


# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. User interface
# --------------------------------------------------

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("SonTek QA/QC"),

  fluidRow(
    column(
      4,
      selectInput(
        "variable",
        "Variable to review:",
        choices = c(
          "Water depth" = "water_depth",
          "Index velocity" = "index_velocity"
        ),
        selected = "water_depth"
      )
    ),
    column(
      4,
      actionButton("prev_month", "Previous month")
    ),
    column(
      4,
      actionButton("next_month", "Next month")
    )
  ),

  uiOutput("month_label"),

  br(),

  plotlyOutput("depth_plot", height = "600px"),

  br(),

fluidRow(
  column(
    3,
    actionButton("flag", "Mark selected: ORR")
  ),
  column(
    3,
    actionButton("flag_noise", "Mark selected: SSN")
  ),
  column(
    3,
    actionButton("unflag", "Remove selected QA/QC flags")
  ),
  column(
    3,
    downloadButton("download", "Download all data")
  )
),

  br(),

  verbatimTextOutput("status")
)


# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Server
# --------------------------------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Keep the full dataset in memory, including flags
  data_r <- reactiveVal(qa_data)

  month_index <- reactiveVal(1L)
  selected_ids <- reactiveVal(integer(0))

  # Choose the suspect column for the selected variable
  current_suspect_col <- reactive({
    if (input$variable == "water_depth") {
      "suspect_depth"
    } else {
      "suspect_velocity"
    }
  })
  
  current_noise_col <- reactive({
  if (input$variable == "water_depth") {
    "noise_depth"
  } else {
    "noise_velocity"
  }
  })

  current_month <- reactive({
    req(length(available_months) > 0)
    available_months[month_index()]
  })

  # Filter BEFORE plotting
  monthly_data <- reactive({
    req(length(available_months) > 0)

    data_r() %>%
      filter(month == current_month())
  })

  output$month_label <- renderUI({
    tags$h4(format(current_month(), "%B %Y"))
  })

  # Reset selection when navigating between months
  observeEvent(input$prev_month, {
    month_index(max(1L, month_index() - 1L))
    selected_ids(integer(0))
  })

  observeEvent(input$next_month, {
    month_index(
      min(length(available_months), month_index() + 1L)
    )
    selected_ids(integer(0))
  })

  # Reset selection when switching variables
  observeEvent(input$variable, {
    selected_ids(integer(0))
  })



# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Plot the selected variable
# --------------------------------------------------

output$depth_plot <- renderPlotly({

  req(nrow(monthly_data()) > 0)

  variable <- input$variable
  suspect_col <- current_suspect_col()

  # Select the correct original flag column
  flag_col <- if (variable == "water_depth") {
    "flag_depth"
  } else {
    "flag_velocity"
  }

  variable_label <- if (variable == "water_depth") {
    "Water depth (m)"
  } else {
    "Index velocity"
  }

  # Prepare all plot and hover columns explicitly
  plot_data <- monthly_data() %>%
    arrange(timestamp) %>%
    mutate(
      hover_value = as.numeric(.data[[variable]]),
      hover_flag = as.character(.data[[flag_col]]),

      hover_suspect = .data[[suspect_col]],
      hover_noise = .data[[current_noise_col()]],

    flag_plot = if_else(
      is.na(.data[[flag_col]]),
      "NA (unflagged)",
      as.character(.data[[flag_col]])
    ),

    point_color = case_when(
      hover_suspect & hover_noise ~ "ORR + SSN",
      hover_suspect ~ "ORR: Out of reasonable range",
      hover_noise ~ "SSN: Suspected sensor noise",
      TRUE ~ flag_plot
    )
  )

  # Generate colors for original flags
  flag_levels <- unique(plot_data$flag_plot)

  regular_levels <- flag_levels[
    flag_levels != "NA (unflagged)"
  ]

  flag_colors <- setNames(
    grDevices::hcl.colors(
      max(1, length(regular_levels)),
      palette = "Dark 3"
    )[seq_along(regular_levels)],
     regular_levels
  )

  flag_colors <- c(
    flag_colors,
      "NA (unflagged)" = "grey75",
      "ORR: Out of reasonable range" = "red",
      "SSN: Suspected sensor noise" = "orange",
      "ORR + SSN" = "purple"
  )

  # Build hover text as a regular dataframe column
  plot_data$hover_text <- paste0(
    "Time: ", plot_data$timestamp,
    "<br>", variable_label, ": ", plot_data$hover_value,
    "<br>Original flag: ",
    ifelse(is.na(plot_data$hover_flag), "NA", plot_data$hover_flag),
    "<br>Out of reasonable range: ", plot_data$hover_suspect,
    "<br>Suspected sensor noise: ", plot_data$hover_noise
  )

  plot_ly(
    data = plot_data,
    x = ~timestamp,
    y = ~hover_value,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    source = "sontek",
    key = ~row_id,
    color = ~point_color,
    colors = flag_colors,
    marker = list(size = 7),
    text = ~hover_text,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = "Timestamp"),
      yaxis = list(title = variable_label),
      dragmode = "select",
      legend = list(
        title = list(text = "Original flag / QA/QC")
      )
    ) %>%
    config(
      displaylogo = FALSE,
      modeBarButtonsToAdd = c("select2d", "lasso2d")
    )
})



  # --------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Capture selected observations
  # --------------------------------------------------

  observeEvent(
    event_data("plotly_selected", source = "sontek"),
    {
      selected <- event_data(
        "plotly_selected",
        source = "sontek"
      )

      if (is.null(selected) || nrow(selected) == 0) {
        selected_ids(integer(0))
      } else {
        selected_ids(as.integer(selected$key))
      }
    },
    ignoreNULL = FALSE
  )


  # --------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Flag selected rows for the active variable
  # --------------------------------------------------

  observeEvent(input$flag, {

    ids <- selected_ids()
    if (length(ids) == 0) return()

    col <- current_suspect_col()
    updated <- data_r()

    updated[[col]][updated$row_id %in% ids] <- TRUE

    data_r(updated)
    qa_data_flagged <<- updated

  print(paste(
    "Variable:", input$variable,
    "| Total ORR observations:",
    sum(updated[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    ))
  })


# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Flag selected rows as Noise
# --------------------------------------------------

  observeEvent(input$flag_noise, {

    ids <- selected_ids()
    if (length(ids) == 0) return()

    col <- current_noise_col()
    updated <- data_r()

    updated[[col]][updated$row_id %in% ids] <- TRUE

    data_r(updated)
    qa_data_flagged <<- updated

  print(paste(
    "Variable:", input$variable,
    "| Total SSN observations:",
    sum(updated[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    ))
  })


  # --------------------------------------------------
  # 8. Remove suspect flags for the active variable
  # --------------------------------------------------

  observeEvent(input$unflag, {

    ids <- selected_ids()
    if (length(ids) == 0) return()

    updated <- data_r()

    suspect_col <- current_suspect_col()
    noise_col <- current_noise_col()

    updated[[suspect_col]][updated$row_id %in% ids] <- FALSE
    updated[[noise_col]][updated$row_id %in% ids] <- FALSE

    data_r(updated)
    qa_data_flagged <<- updated

  print(paste(
    "Variable:", input$variable,
    "| Selected observations cleared of ORR and SSN flags:",
    length(ids)
    ))
  })


  # --------------------------------------------------
  # 9. Status summary
  # --------------------------------------------------

  output$status <- renderPrint({

    suspect_col <- current_suspect_col()
    noise_col <- current_noise_col()

    cat("Variable:", input$variable, "\n")
    cat("Month:", format(current_month(), "%B %Y"), "\n")
    cat("Points in current month:", nrow(monthly_data()), "\n\n")

    cat("ORR flags this month:",
      sum(monthly_data()[[suspect_col]], na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

    cat("SSN flags this month:",
      sum(monthly_data()[[noise_col]], na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

    cat("ORR flags across all months:\n")
    cat("  Depth:",
      sum(data_r()$suspect_depth, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("  Velocity:",
      sum(data_r()$suspect_velocity, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

    cat("SSN flags across all months:\n")
    cat("  Depth:",
      sum(data_r()$noise_depth, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("  Velocity:",
      sum(data_r()$noise_velocity, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  })


  # --------------------------------------------------
  # 10. Download ALL data
  # --------------------------------------------------

  output$download <- downloadHandler(

    filename = function() {
      paste0("SonTek_QAQC_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")
    },

    content = function(file) {
      write.csv(
        data_r() %>% select(-month, -row_id),
        file,
        row.names = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
}

shinyApp(ui, server)




```

## Combine suspect flags with existing programmatic flags
```{r}

# Function to append a flag without creating duplicates
append_flag <- function(existing_flag, new_flag) {

  if (is.na(existing_flag) || existing_flag == "") {
    return(new_flag)
  }

  existing_flags <- trimws(
    unlist(strsplit(existing_flag, ","))
  )

  if (new_flag %in% existing_flags) {
    return(existing_flag)
  }

  paste(existing_flag, new_flag, sep = ", ")
}


# Use the function to add the ORR and SSN flags 
qa_data_flags <- qa_data_flagged %>%
  mutate(

    # Depth flags
    flag_depth = mapply(
      function(flag, orr, noise) {

        if (isTRUE(orr)) {
          flag <- append_flag(flag, "ORR")
        }

        if (isTRUE(noise)) {
          flag <- append_flag(flag, "SSN")
        }

        flag
      },
      flag_depth,
      suspect_depth,
      noise_depth,
      USE.NAMES = FALSE
    ),

    # Velocity flags
    flag_velocity = mapply(
      function(flag, orr, noise) {

        if (isTRUE(orr)) {
          flag <- append_flag(flag, "ORR")
        }

        if (isTRUE(noise)) {
          flag <- append_flag(flag, "SSN")
        }

        flag
      },
      flag_velocity,
      suspect_velocity,
      noise_velocity,
      USE.NAMES = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%

  # Remove temporary QA/QC columns
  select(
    -suspect_depth,
    -suspect_velocity,
    -noise_depth,
    -noise_velocity,
    -row_id,
    -month
  )


```

## Add or change QARTOD flag when ORR or SSN 
```{r}

qa_data_flags_qartod <- qa_data_flags %>%
  mutate(
    # Change QARTOD depth flag to 4 when system codes are present
    QARTOD_flag_depth = case_when(
      grepl("(^|, )(OOB|ORR|OOS|SSN)(,|$)", flag_depth) ~ 4L,
      TRUE ~ QARTOD_flag_depth
    ),

    # Change QARTOD velocity flag to 4 when system codes are present
    QARTOD_flag_velocity = case_when(
      grepl("(^|, )(OOB|ORR|OOS|SSN)(,|$)", flag_depth) ~ 4L,
      TRUE ~ QARTOD_flag_velocity
    )
  )

```

## Make any data that has OOB, ORR, SSN, or OSS flag into NA 
```{r}

#Lettered Flags: 
# OOB = Out of instrument's sensor bounds 
# OOS = Out of service, when the instrument is out of water or being serviced 
# SSF = Sontek system flag, this flag indicates that there is a system code in the system_status column 
# ORR = Out of reasonable range for this site (eg. if the depth is at a height not seen at this location)
# SSN = Suspected sensor noise, this is used when data is obvious noise in comparison to surrounding points 

## Make any data that has OOB, ORR, or OSS flag into NA 
qa_data_na <- qa_data_flags_qartod %>%
  mutate(
    water_depth = if_else(
      grepl("OOB|ORR|OOS|SSN", coalesce(flag_depth, "")),
      NA_real_, water_depth
    ),
    cross_area = if_else(
      grepl("OOB|ORR|OOS|SSN", coalesce(flag_depth, "")),
      NA_real_, cross_area
    ),
    index_velocity = if_else(
      grepl("OOB|ORR|OOS|SSN", coalesce(flag_velocity, "")),
      NA_real_, index_velocity
    ),
    flowrate = if_else(
      grepl("OOB|ORR|OOS|SSN", coalesce(flag_velocity, "")),
      NA_real_, flowrate
    ),
    mean_velocity = if_else(
      grepl("OOB|ORR|OOS|SSN", coalesce(flag_velocity, "")),
      NA_real_, mean_velocity
    )
  )

qa_data_na <- qa_data_na %>%
  mutate(
    # Depth-related SSF flags
    water_depth = if_else(
      flag_depth == "SSF" & QARTOD_flag_depth == 4,
      NA_real_, water_depth
    ),
    cross_area = if_else(
      flag_depth == "SSF" & QARTOD_flag_depth == 4,
      NA_real_, cross_area
    ),

    # Velocity-related SSF flags
    index_velocity = if_else(
      flag_velocity == "SSF" & QARTOD_flag_velocity == 4,
      NA_real_, index_velocity
    ),
    flowrate = if_else(
      flag_velocity == "SSF" & QARTOD_flag_velocity == 4,
      NA_real_, flowrate
    ),
    mean_velocity = if_else(
      flag_velocity == "SSF" & QARTOD_flag_velocity == 4,
      NA_real_, mean_velocity
    )
  )

#Select only columns that we want to the final data frame 
qa_data_na_selected <- qa_data_na %>%
  select(timestamp, water_temperature, water_depth, water_elevation, 
         index_velocity, velocity_x_zxc, velocity_x_zzc, velocity_x_zxl, velocity_x_zxr, mean_velocity, 
         flowrate, stage, cross_area, 
         snr1, snr2, snr3, snr4, 
         pitch_angle, roll_angle, batt_vol_sontek,
         perc_submergance, ice_score, 
         system_status, flag_depth, QARTOD_flag_depth, flag_velocity, QARTOD_flag_velocity)


#quick sanity check plot the data 
chk_plot <- ggplot(qa_data_na_selected, aes(timestamp, as.numeric(water_depth), color=flag_depth)) + #color=as.factor(QARTOD_flag_depth))) + 
                      geom_point() + theme_classic() + labs(x="Time Stamp", y="Water Depth (m)")

chk_plot
  

```



## Determine Q and Volume to add to the dataframe 
```{r}

#We can determine Q manually for this site using the cross sectional area and the velocity 

#GCReW Flume Size info 
channel_bottom_width = 1.915 #meters - width of the bottom of the channel according to 2022 sontek config file
channel_top_width = 1.915 #meters - width of the top of the channel according to 2022 sontek config file
channel_depth = 2.00 #meters - depth of the channel according to 2022 sontek config file 

#add creek bathymetry to the sontek data frame 
qa_data_na$channel_bottom_width <- channel_bottom_width
qa_data_na$channel_depth <- channel_depth
qa_data_na$channel_top_width <- channel_top_width 

#Calculate the area at each time step based on the bathy and the depth of water 
qa_data_na_cross_area <- qa_data_na %>%
  mutate(
    channel_cross_area = water_depth * channel_bottom_width
  )

#calculate the discharge and the volume at each time step 
qa_data_na_discharge <- qa_data_na_cross_area %>%
  mutate(
    index_Q_discharge = channel_cross_area * index_velocity,
    mean_Q_discharge = channel_cross_area * mean_velocity) 



chk_Q_plot <- ggplot(qa_data_na_discharge, aes(timestamp, as.numeric(index_Q_discharge))) + 
                      geom_point() + theme_classic() + labs(x="Time Stamp", y="Q (m3/s)")

chk_Q_plot
  

```

```{r}
final_data_na_selected <- qa_data_na_discharge %>%

         index_velocity, velocity_x_zxc, velocity_x_zzc, velocity_x_zxl, velocity_x_zxr, mean_velocity, 
         flowrate, stage, cross_area, 
         #channel_cross_area, 
         index_Q_discharge, mean_Q_discharge,
         snr1, snr2, snr3, snr4, 
         pitch_angle, roll_angle, batt_vol_sontek,
         perc_submergance, ice_score, 
         system_status, 
         flag_depth, QARTOD_flag_depth, flag_velocity, QARTOD_flag_velocity)

#write out the data to the L2 folder making the name from the year set above 
write.csv(
  final_data_na_selected,
  file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Sontek_", year_qaing, "_L2.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)


```

## Data Description 
```{r data description}

#Create a text file that has the description of the data - This ideally should match the text that is in the data READ.ME 

datadescription <- "These data are measurements of water temperature, depth, velocity, and discharge made at the Smithsonian Environmental Research Center's Global Change Research Wetland (GCReW) in the Kirkpatrick Marsh along the Rhode River in Edgewater, MD, USA. Measurements were made  with a Sontek IQ series acoustic doupler current profiler (ADCP) at the GCReW Flume (38.87486, -76.5465) through which a tidal creek flows. The Sontek ADCP is affixed to a PVC pipe bolted to the center of the flume that extended to just above the sediment surface. Measurements were collected every six minutes and recorded by a Campbell Scientific CR1000x logger as described by Wilson et al. (in review). These are L2 data, where L0 would be raw data is received by the logger from the instrument, L1 has been processed with programmatic quality checks for data out of the instrument bounds (OOR), out of service when the instrument is down for cleaning or servicing (OOS), and flagged for internal system status codes (SSF). L2 data have been visualized and flagged manually to identify data that is out of reasonalbe range for this location (ORR) or for suspected sensor noise (SSN). Additionally the depth and index velocity data are flagged with QARTOD codes (1=Pass, 2=Not Evaluated, 3=Suspect or Of High Interest, 4=Fail, 9=Missing Data) according to the NOAA Manual for Real-Time Quality Control of In-Situ Current Observations QARTOD manual version 2.1 (2019).Water depth and index velocity measurements were manually QAQC'd, then those data, along with any dependent data (cross sectional area, mean velocity, flowrate) were made to be NA if flags OOB, OOR, OOS, or SSN were present. Data that was only flagged with SSF, but had QARTOD flags equal to 4 were also made to be NA, which indicate a change in tilt values that were input into the sontek and flag the user so that the IQ mount can be checked. Discharge, Q (m3/s), was calculated as the cross sectional area * velocity using both index velocity and mean velocity measured by the Sontek IQ and is reported here. The QAQC procedures are outlined and the code to produce these data from L1 are available on GitHub (link)."


#write to a text file 
writeLines(datadescription, "L2_data/DataDescription.txt")


```

## Create Author List 
```{r create author list}

#Pull in the common synoptic authors list: 
authors_common <- read.csv(here("Figshare/", "SERC_LateralFlux_common_author_list.csv"))


#create a list of the last names you want to pull 
names_we_want <- c("Wilson", "Miller", "Noyce", "Peresta","Read", "Reynolds", "Rich" , "Megonigal")
order_of_authors <- c(1:length(names_we_want))

authors <- data.frame(
  order_of_authors = unlist(order_of_authors), 
  last_name = unlist(names_we_want)
)

#Subset the common list for the names that we want 
author_list <- authors %>% 
  left_join(authors_common, by = "last_name")

#if you need to add any other authors 
others <- data.frame(
  first_name = c("first_name1", "first_name2"), 
  last_name = c("last_name1", "last_name2"), 
  orcid = c("orcid_id1", "orcid_id2"), 
  affiliation = c("affiliation1", "affiliation2"), 
  email = c("email1", "email2"), 
  order_of_authors = c((length(names_we_want)+1):(length(names_we_want)+2))
)

#add in the other authors 
#author_list <- bind_rows(author_list, others)

#write out the author list associated with the data:
write.csv(author_list, "L2_data/AuthorList.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
